execution_policy.public_metadata_only: engine/path role, safe hashes, explicitly controlled rows; no credentials/tokens/raw process environments

gates.entrypoint: Actual unchanged default Source /app/docker/entrypoint.sh with DB_ENGINE=sqlite and owned data/dependencies
assertions: Verify actual startup code bytes against pinned source refs.
Observe effective settings/environment in actual migration, web and worker login-shell launch path.
Capture PostgreSQL readiness and SQLite file/session activity and actual exits.
A PostgreSQL selection is a deployment observation, never SQLite acceptance.

configuration_controls.test_scope: manage.py test uses settings_test and :memory: fallback independently; cannot stand in for production file path

gates.pre_redis_flag: Record DISPATCHARR_SKIP_REDIS_CACHE=1 where the actual AIO pre-Redis launch uses it; do not silently change deployment configuration.
assertions: Verify actual engine/path is SQLite /data/dispatcharr.db in the owned context.
Capture actual exit, safe stdout/stderr hashes, first failed migration and applied prefix.
Keep dependency/environment failures separate from SQL portability failures.
forbidden_substitutes: SQL patches or generated replacement app schema
in-memory test fallback as production acceptance

gates.requires: Unmodified production-settings SQLite bootstrap succeeds, or legitimate existing owned SQLite application file with exact Original version/history and migration provenance.
gates.on_failed_bootstrap: Record literal failure; dependent application gates remain blocked/not_run. No legitimate current-schema SQLite application file is supplied by the captured source archive.

workflow: Reuse actual Source web/default worker/Beat context for initialization/login and controlled channel/settings reads/writes.
Produce real context-local archive through REST create/status/download; verify complete SQLite member signature and metadata.
Mutate controlled credentials/settings/channel via ordinary APIs.
Restore through actual REST producer/worker; observe task migrate result and same-instance restored HTTP/SQL behavior.
Observe file/journal sidecars and actual process identities.
gates.source_backend_calls_from_controller: No direct service/task/migrate-body replay; public CLI/REST entry points only.

cells: Existing .db.bak and Source actual rollback behavior
assertions: Preserve actual failed result versus backend FAILURE distinction.
Observe literal database bytes/backup/journal/locks and real owner retirement.
Do not infer SQL/session closure from client loss or process exit alone.

gates.requires: Concrete Source authority plus coherent Native SQLite persistence/lifecycle implementation
assertions: Run the same required application matrix on one built Native candidate.
Measure equivalent useful work under fixed budgets in a quiet window.

credits: Original Dispatcharr authors and contributors retain full application and algorithm credit; Django, Python/SQLite, PostgreSQL, Celery/Kombu and dependency authors retain their credit and licenses.
